response.speaker: Svea
response.text: That's the question.

response.speaker: MC
response.text: Your answer, then.

response.speaker: Svea
response.text: Yeah. Let me get it out.

choices.text: We can try spending time together and be honest if it doesn't feel right.

response.speaker: Svea
response.text: Fair. No pretending because someone asked nicely.

response.speaker: MC
response.text: Agreed.

response.speaker: Svea
response.text: Good. Here's where I'm at.

choices.text: You don't have to act so independent. I'll be the one you rely on.

response.speaker: Svea
response.text: I wasn't auditioning for someone to take over.

response.speaker: MC
response.text: I meant I'd be there for you.

response.speaker: Svea
response.text: Then be here and listen to what I'm saying.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The alarm goes off while I'm checking whether the alarm is set. A strong start.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: All right. I'm awake. We can both stop trying so hard.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Seiran High School. The name still looks strange on my admission papers.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I checked the acceptance list twice, then a third time in case the first two were a shared misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mum called it a fresh start. My old classmate called it 'a place where even the vending machines probably get better grades than us.'

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I also promised myself I wouldn't spend high school replaying junior high. The confession I postponed until she was already dating someone.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The message I rewrote so many times that I sent it to the wrong group.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The perfectly ordinary rejection I somehow turned into an entire season of embarrassment.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: No speeches this time. Learn people's names. Say hello like a normal person.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Manageable goals. I put on the blazer before I can add any more.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The school is large enough to make me walk a little straighter. Not because anyone is watching. Because I can't quite believe they're letting me in.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Students move past in new uniforms and small nervous groups. I recognize nobody.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Several people look as if they recognize nobody with more confidence than I do.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Main entrance. Lobby. Ceremony. I can manage three destinations.

lines.speaker: PA
lines.text: Welcome to Seiran High School. Please keep your orientation booklet with you during today's campus walk.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The ceremony contains advice about responsibility, opportunity and where to put indoor shoes. I write down the last part. It seems immediately useful.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Takahashi, Ren? Good. You have a guided activity day. Visit the marked areas, learn the routes and return any forms before you leave.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Ask staff if a door is closed.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I turn the little campus map the wrong way up, correct it and hope the student beside me hasn't noticed.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Classrooms A, B and C share the main corridor. The library is at the east end, the infirmary at the west. Canteen, lobby and sports field are downstairs.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Home is through the main gate, not through a classroom window.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: A few people laugh. I decide I like teachers who plan for that possibility.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: The arrow points toward the stairs. The room is on this floor.

lines.speaker: Classmate
lines.text: It was like that when I got here.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: Then we have discovered a problem without discovering a culprit. Hold this end, please.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Long silver hair, perfectly straight shoulders, a voice that makes fixing a paper sign sound like settling a formal dispute.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: Bozhe moy... Slowly. We are moving paper, not launching it.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Someone calls her Katya. She checks that the arrow is right, then thanks the other student so quickly I nearly miss it.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I'd better learn where that room is before she catches me following the old arrow.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: Left at the noticeboard, then the stairs. No, sorry—your left. I turned around halfway through my own instructions.

lines.speaker: Classmate
lines.text: Are you sure you're new here too?

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: Extremely new. I just got lost earlier than you did.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Pink bob, brown eyes behind round glasses, three people listening and several explanations already waiting their turn.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: I'm Akira. If we get lost together, it becomes a group activity.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The group goes with her. She hasn't noticed me standing by the vending machine, holding the same booklet as if it might eventually begin speaking.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The girl by the window draws a line, looks up and rubs it out again. Outside, a cloud moves beyond the edge of the roof.

lines.speaker: Librarian
lines.text: Seo-yun? We're putting the donated books over here.

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: I'll be there in a moment. It keeps changing shape.

lines.speaker: Librarian
lines.text: The cloud?

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: Yes. A rather inconsiderate subject.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I came in to find the library. For a moment, I forget to check what time it closes.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: If you haven't eaten, I have a spare lunch. You can say no. I brought it before I knew whether anyone would want it.

lines.speaker: Classmate
lines.text: Are you one of the older students helping today?

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: No. First year. Just as lost as everyone else, I suspect.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Mari, eat yours too. I can see that lid is still closed.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: Ah. Yes. In a moment.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Salmon-colored hair tied low, calm blue-green eyes, both hands carefully holding a lunch that isn't for her.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I check the infirmary mark on the map and keep walking. I don't need to invent a reason to go inside.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: One more, Svea. Then give the next group a turn.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: Classmate
lines.text: Thought you always got those.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: You thought wrong. Watch your feet. They're over the line.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: She passes the ball back and moves aside. A younger-looking student fumbles the next catch; she quietly slows the return pass.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Her shirt collar is loose, her blazer open, her expression hard to read. The careful pass tells me more than the expression does.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: By the time I finish the tour, I know where to eat, where to return a book and which corridor sign is least likely to be wrong.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I also have five names in my head. Katya. Akira. Seo-yun. Mari. Svea.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Learn people's names. That part worked.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I haven't had a proper conversation with any of them. For once, I'm going to let that be the beginning instead of treating it as a failure.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The school felt less impossible from the inside. Mostly it was doors, people trying to find other doors, and teachers pretending we all knew where we were

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: going.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Nobody fell in love with me on sight. Tragic. I suppose I'll have to become someone they actually know.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I fold the map along the wrong crease, open it and try again.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Tomorrow, then. A normal hello. I can start there.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The uniform takes less time today. The tie has not improved at the same speed.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Close enough. School has a lot of people in it; one of them can probably explain knots.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I check my bag before leaving. Book, homework, lunch, the pen I thought I'd lost yesterday.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: A rare complete set.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The alarm sounds slightly less personal this morning. Maybe I'm getting used to it.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Or the batteries are tired. We have that in common.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The map stays on the desk. I know the route now.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: That's one kind of progress.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I put my bag down and finally stop carrying the whole day on one shoulder.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Homework, shower, sleep. An ambitious schedule.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: A few things went well. A few things will sound different when I replay them later.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I write down what I actually need to remember before the imagined versions take over.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I could stay longer. Today, I'd rather go home while I still have the energy to finish my own work.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Leaving early isn't the same thing as missing everything.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Some days are mostly classes and ordinary errands. Not every afternoon needs a scene worth retelling.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Tomorrow I can check the schedule before deciding I've missed my chance.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I remember the moment when I stopped trying to sound useful and actually listened. I'd like to notice it sooner next time.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I didn't like how that conversation ended. Explaining what I meant won't help much if I never look at what I actually said.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I'm still not sure how that came across. People don't come with an answer sheet. I can try asking more clearly next time.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Sunday goes to laundry, homework and an attempt to convince my room it has a floor. By evening, I know where my school bag is again.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Wait. Saying I deserved a chance was unfair. You don't owe me a date. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: Good. I would rather not begin anything with an invoice attached. I know you can listen; do so now.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I shouldn't have pushed for a yes. I wanted an answer and got scared of the one I might hear.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: Okay. I can hear the apology. Please don't make being clear mean agreeing with you. Let me choose my answer.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I shouldn't have asked you to promise to stay. Your plans are yours. I was afraid, and I made it your problem.

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: Thank you for correcting it. I can care about someone without making myself smaller. Please remember that.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: That sounded as if I was looking for someone to take care of me. I'm sorry. I want to know you, including what you need.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: Then listen to this answer as mine. I don't want to earn it by being endlessly useful.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: That came out like I wanted to take over. I don't. I'm sorry. I'll stop explaining and hear your answer.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: Good. One terrible sentence doesn't erase everything else. Doesn't get a free pass either. Listen.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: I like you too. There. An entirely ordinary sentence. Apparently beyond my ordinary capabilities.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: You hid it better than I did.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: That is a very low standard.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: There is a café near the station. Saturday, if you are free.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: A date?

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: Yes, Takahashi—Ren. Bozhe moy. I am attempting to eliminate ambiguity, not create more of it.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Saturday works.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I used to imagine that a confession would be the moment I finally said everything perfectly.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Instead, I'm smiling so hard I can barely unwrap the bread.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: And if you dislike the café, say so. I have no intention of dating somebody who agrees with me out of fear.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: What if I disagree out of terrible taste?

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: We shall have to see how terrible. And don't smile like that, durak. You'll make me smile too.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The gate closes behind us. There are ordinary things to decide now: which street to take, whether it will rain, when I can see her again.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I want the chance to learn them.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: I value the time we have spent together. I cannot honestly call what I feel romance.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: You are allowed to look disappointed. I would prefer that to a very brave lie.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I was hoping for a different answer. But I don't want one you have to force.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: Will sitting here be uncomfortable?

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: A little, probably. Not forever.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: Tell me if you need room. I can manage a direct answer.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: There is no sudden trick that changes what she said. There is also no reason to pretend the afternoons meant nothing.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: You can still send me the name of that piano piece.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: I already did. You spelled it incorrectly in your notes.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Of course I did.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: For now, I take the seat across from her. Friendship is a different answer. It is still an answer worth treating carefully.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: I do not want to date you. I also think we need some distance.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Because of what I just said?

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: Because of more than one afternoon. I have tried to tell you when something mattered to me. Too often, you treated it as something to get around.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I start preparing an explanation. Hearing it in my head, I realize it would be another request for her to make this easier for me.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I heard you. I won't keep asking.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: Your section is in the copy on the left. You should keep it.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Right. Thank you for working with me.

lines.speaker: Katya
lines.text: We did finish it.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The empty chair does not accuse me. It is simply empty. She is allowed to decide who sits beside her, and I do not get to turn that into another test of her

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: kindness.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Next time I care about somebody, I want to listen before I'm afraid of losing them.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: I want that. A date. Just us. I tried practicing that without the giant smile, but the giant smile appears to be included.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Keep the smile. I like it.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: I like you, Ren. That's what I keep coming back to. No clever explanation. You, specifically. It's inconveniently hard to improve on.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I had a good reply ready. It leaves my head before I can use it.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I like you too.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: Daebak. Okay. Excellent. Two people. Same answer. Why was that harder than the whole demo?

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: Saturday. There's a café I'd like to show you. After that, maybe a walk. I will try not to turn it into a guided lecture.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: One topic allowed.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: You're negotiating with the wrong girl. One topic has subtopics, Ren. You should have read the small print.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: She's laughing now, but she isn't rushing past what happened. Neither am I.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Saturday is a date, and today is the first time holding her hand feels simple enough to enjoy.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: I like being with you. I don't feel the part I think you're asking for. I kept checking because I didn't want to give you the wrong answer.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Thanks for not giving me the easy one.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: I'm not sure there was an easy one.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: If being friends is difficult right now, you can say so. I won't turn it into an emergency project.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: A little difficult. I'd like to try, with some room to be awkward.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: Awkward I can handle. Unclear instructions are the real enemy.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: A week later, we have lunch with the project group. She asks before showing anyone a photo, then catches me noticing.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: What? Some features do make it into the final version.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I'm glad that one did.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I don't secretly count the afternoon as progress toward changing her mind. We finished something useful together.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I can let that be true without asking it to become something else.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: I don't want to date you. I'm going to say that plainly, because I've spent too long hoping a softer version would make this easier.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I thought we were getting closer.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: Sometimes we were. Other times, I felt like being useful was the part of me you were waiting for. I don't want to build a relationship around that feeling.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Her voice isn't loud. That makes it harder to pretend I misunderstood.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: All right. I'll give you space.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: Thank you. We can keep the handover polite. We don't have to pretend nothing happened.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The project will keep working without either of us beside it. I'm glad we managed that, even if I wish I'd handled the rest differently.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: Your copy is in the class folder. The instructions are on the first page.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Got it. Good luck with the next idea.

lines.speaker: Akira
lines.text: Thanks. I'm going to take a break before I start one.

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: I like you too. Joahaeyo... I practiced it in both languages. Neither version feels easier while you're looking at me.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I think it did very well.

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: You can look at this one.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The second chair isn't a promise that I'll always be there. It is a place she has chosen to draw for me now.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Would you like to go for a walk after school? A proper date.

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: Yes. And Ren? Somewhere with a view you like. I want to know what you notice too.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I may need to discover an interesting view first.

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: We can start with an ordinary one. I have good evidence that those can work.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Her future is still wide and uncertain. Mine is too. For the first time, I don't feel that uncertainty as a question I have to answer before I'm allowed to be happy.

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: I care about you. I don't think what I feel is the same as what you're asking for.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Thank you for telling me.

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: I don't want to lose a friendship by giving you a hopeful answer I can't mean.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I let the disappointment arrive without asking her to make it smaller.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Can I have some time to get used to it?

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: This is very careful recruiting.

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: I wanted the invitation to be easy to decline.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I can help for a while.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: She hands me the list. I take it because I want to be here, not because I think the right number of afternoons will change her answer.

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: I don't want a romantic relationship with you. I need more distance than we've had.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Did I make you feel trapped?

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: Too often, I felt that there was an answer you wanted and that my own answer was something we would have to get past.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Her hands rest on the closed journal. I know better than to ask to see the page that might explain everything in a way I prefer.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I'm sorry. I won't ask you to reconsider.

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: Thank you for hearing me now.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I had begun imagining a future with her before I learned how to leave space for the one she wanted. She isn't taking that future away from me.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: It was never mine to reserve.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I hope the adviser appointment helps.

lines.speaker: Seo-yun
lines.text: It already has. I have a few things I can do next.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: I would like that. Yes, Ren. A date. Oh... saying your name without the rest of it feels surprisingly bold.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Ren is fine. And you don't have to worry about getting every word right.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: Good. You'll still have to tell me when I offer you lunch instead of answering a question. Gently, please. I'm likely to be embarrassed already.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Can we have the conversation and the food?

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: Yes. Though some days I may ask you to bring lunch.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I'll learn something that survives the trip to school.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The nurse passes the open doorway and reminds us when the block ends. Mari answers without letting go of my hand.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: Yes. Otsukaresama deshita—thank you for today. We're leaving on time. I promise.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: Stay a little. Not because I need help with anything.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I'd like that.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: She closes her eyes for one peaceful breath. I don't have to turn the moment into a promise about fixing her life.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Today she has chosen something for herself, and I'm glad it includes me.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: I care about you, Takahashi-kun. But I don't want to date you. I kept trying to find a kinder sentence. I think...

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: I think this is the kindest one I can actually mean.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I'm glad you did.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Disappointed. I'll be all right. You don't have to pour tea over the whole problem.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: That would be a terrible use of tea.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: We both smile, a little awkwardly. Her answer remains what it is.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: I brought one tea bag. The spare tin is there if you want some.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I remember where it is.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: We make our own cups. The conversation is ordinary and occasionally uneven.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I don't pretend that being her friend was my plan all along, and she doesn't try to repay my disappointment by doing more for me.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: It's nice to see you.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: It's nice to see you too.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: I don't want to date you. I need some distance from the way things have been between us.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I thought you liked looking after me.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: Sometimes I did. I wanted you to be interested in the rest of me too.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: When I tried to say what I needed, I often felt I was making our time together less convenient for you.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The cup in front of her is still full. I almost tell her to drink it, then stop. She has already told me what matters.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I'm sorry. I won't try to talk you out of it.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I go home without an extra lunch or an offer to check my homework. Those things were never proof that she owed me more.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Take care, Mari.

lines.speaker: Mari
lines.text: You too.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: Yeah. I want that. A date. With you, Ren. ...There. Said it. Don't make the face.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I'm trying not to grin. It's not going well.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: Yeah. I noticed.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: We could get lunch on Saturday.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: Actual lunch. Big plates. If somebody serves one leaf and calls it a concept, we're leaving.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I have learned at least one thing about you.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: Hopefully more than one.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: She takes the ball back and bounces it once, collecting herself. Her smile returns before she can hide it.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: Boku... I'm fine on my own. Always was. You get that, yeah?

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: Good. I want you here anyway.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I don't need to find a weakness that makes her stay. She's beside me because she wants to be, and she's finally said it plainly enough that even I can't miss

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: it.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: I like you, Takahashi. Just... not like that. Took a while to be sure. Don't want to keep you guessing now I am.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: You can look disappointed. I'm not going to tell you how to take it.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: That blunt permission is unexpectedly useful. I let out the breath I've been holding.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I am disappointed. I still like being around you.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: Then take the time you need. Court isn't going anywhere.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Training paid off.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: One catch. Don't give a speech.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Nothing secret is being promised. I don't have to pretend I never wanted more, but I can enjoy being on the same side of the court without treating the game

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: as another chance to win her over.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: Lunch?

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Actual lunch?

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: Good. You remember.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: No. I don't want to date you. I'd rather we stop meeting like this for a while.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I didn't think things were that bad.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: I kept telling you when something bothered me. Too often, you treated it like I was putting on an act you had to get past.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: She shifts the ball under her arm and waits. There isn't a hidden smile underneath the answer.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: I understand. I'll give you space.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I had wanted to be the person who saw some secret softer version of her.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: She was showing me who she was all along: hungry after practice, bad at lying, kind to animals, tired some days, interested in her own life.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Good luck at the next practice.

lines.speaker: Svea
lines.text: Thanks. Take care, Takahashi.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Tomorrow she'll still have a court, a team and things she wants to do.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: I need to learn how to care about somebody without making myself the reason for all of them.
